title: Love Never Fails
story:
A young boy had a small plant that his mother had given him to care for.

Every morning, he remembered to water it and place it where it could receive sunlight.

Some days the plant looked healthy and strong. On other days, its leaves became weak, and the boy wondered if it would survive.

One morning, after a particularly difficult week, he noticed a small new leaf growing.

He was excited and ran to show his mother.

She smiled and said, "Good things often take time. Keep caring for it."

The boy continued to care for the plant even when he could not immediately see the results.

Love can be like that.

Real love is not only shown when everything is easy or when people treat us well.

It remains faithful when relationships become difficult, when misunderstandings happen, and when we are disappointed.

Paul reminds us that love never fails.

Many things in life are temporary. Knowledge changes, abilities may fade, circumstances come and go, and even things that seem important today may not last forever.

But genuine love has lasting value because it reflects the character of God.

God's love does not give up when we struggle. He patiently forgives, restores, and continues to call us closer to Him.

As followers of Christ, we are also called to love others with patience and faithfulness.

There may be people who are difficult to love, relationships that have been hurt, or situations where forgiveness feels hard.

Yet choosing love can bring healing where anger cannot.

Love does not mean accepting everything that is wrong. It means choosing what is good, truthful, patient, and compassionate.

Today, ask God to help you love someone who is difficult to love.

Your loving action may seem small, but God can use it to bring hope, healing, and change.

Remember that many things will pass away, but love remains.
life_lesson: True love does not give up easily. Because God's love never fails, choose to love others with patience, forgiveness, truth, and faithfulness even when relationships are difficult.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for loving me with a love that never fails.

Teach me to love others in the same way You have loved me.

Give me patience when people disappoint me and grace when relationships become difficult.

Help me forgive those who have hurt me and choose love instead of anger or bitterness.

Teach me to speak the truth with kindness and to show compassion to those who are struggling.

When I feel like giving up on someone, remind me of Your patience and faithfulness toward me.

Help my love be sincere and reflected through my words, choices, and actions.

Use my love to bring encouragement, healing, and hope to the people around me.

Thank You that while many things in this world will pass away, Your love remains forever.

May my life reflect the unfailing love of Christ.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there someone you are finding difficult to love or forgive?

How has God's unfailing love toward you changed the way you treat others?

What is one loving action you can take today, even if the other person does not respond the way you expect?
verse: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.
